pages.text: Spell proficiency increases by 1 whenever a spell is used.$(br2)Tiers: Beginner on learning, Minor at 100, Great at 500, Perfected at 1000, and Peak at 10000.

$(br)Yuqi Shu: learned automatically at Foundation Establishment Early.$(br)Use it while looking at a released flying sword to call it behind you. The button in its spell description switches between calling only the looked-at sword and calling all owned swords in a 3-block area.

$(br)Controlled flying swords cost 3 qi per sword each second. Punch fires one sword, while sneaking and punching fires up to six. Swords return to the ground after impact and only answer the player who released them.

pages.title: Golden Core Flight
pages.text: Golden Core and higher can use creative-style flight. Enable Golden Core flight in settings, then double-tap Jump to take off or stop flying. Jump rises; Sneak descends. WASD moves horizontally. Looking up or down does not steer vertical movement.

pages.title: Realm Speed Caps
pages.text: Speeds are relative to vanilla creative flight. Golden Core: up to x5. Nascent Soul: up to x10. Soul Transformation and higher: up to x20.$(br2)Enable flight mouse-wheel speed control in settings to adjust the selected speed. Faster flight costs more qi.

pages.title: Sword Flight
pages.text: Golden Core required. All swords can be released and controlled: vanilla swords, Peachwood, Copper Coin, Flying Sword, Black Iron Jian, Black Iron Greatsword, Thunderwood, Seven-Star and manifested swords.$(br2)Sabers, spears, fans and other weapons cannot use this system.

pages.title: Using Any Sword
pages.text: Release a sword with Release / Recall Sword, then control it with Yuqi Shu. Near a visible controlled sword, press Toggle Sword Flight (default N; remappable).$(br2)The sword lies flat beneath your feet. Double-tap Jump to take off; Jump rises, Sneak descends. You use normal player movement, not a vehicle.

pages.title: Sword Speed Bonus
pages.text: Sword flight uses the same Jump, Sneak, WASD and speed controls as ordinary flight. Sneak descends; it does not dismount.$(br2)Your selected speed is multiplied by 1.5 after the realm cap: x5 becomes x7.5; x10 becomes x15; x20 becomes x30. Toggle Sword Flight again to remove the bonus and resume ordinary flight.

pages.title: Controlling the Blade
pages.text: The blade beneath your feet cannot be launched or picked up while sword flight is enabled; other controlled swords can still attack. Toggle sword flight off to recall its blade.$(br2)Flight and sword control consume qi. If flight becomes unavailable, the sword bonus ends. Normal player collision prevents flying through terrain.

pages.title: Qi Release
pages.text: Golden Core and higher: enter combat mode, then press G to release qi. Shift + scroll adjusts 100–200%. At 200%, a moving domain extends 20 blocks from you. Press G again to stop. See the Qi Domains entry for costs, clashes and method powers.
